selection: First passing attempt per configuration; round-robin unresolved configurations; seeds 0,1,...; all attempts retained

failure: Failed/incomplete/nonfinite runs never qualify; deterministic technical errors block configuration for repair; disk guard pauses before exhaustion

scaffold_test_appearance: Mean of learned training-camera embeddings for all novel test views, because separate test camera IDs do not index the training embeddings; explicit reconstruction choice
metrics: Native common SSIM, PSNR, LPIPS VGG 0.1; RGB PNG, float32 arithmetic mean over full prescribed test split
execution_update: User explicitly requires local machine, both physical GPUs 0 and 1; remote CUDA execution disabled
previous_phase: Remote attempts retained with original host identities; one selected result preserved
